//projectRoot: Absolute path to your TeamCode Java SOURCE ROOT — the folder that directly contains 'org/'. On a stock FTC project that is .../TeamCode/src/main/java

//allowGit: true = the export panel shows the git branch and offers per-file 'git add' / 'git rm --cached'. It never commits or pushes.
